you_should_know.title: Can mining near Minnesota's Boundary Waters be carried out safely?
you_should_know.summary: Gov. Tim Walz announced an executive order banning copper and nickel mining near the Boundary Waters, the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness, lake country on the Canadian border roughly 250 miles north of Minneapolis, after Congress voted in April to overturn a 20-year ban. The order sharpened a long-standing split: Twin Metals says a copper-nickel mine would bring hundreds of union jobs and 1,400 additional positions and keep the industry alive in northern Minnesota, while opponents say the risk to the watershed and the wilderness area is not worth the trade-offs, and whether such a mine can operate safely depends on who is asked.
